root_idea.summary: The root centers on a raised wall or boundary and, in a second branch, on something emerging or protruding.
root_idea.development: The wall sense extends to foundations, enclosures, dams, and walled gardens; the emergence branch describes vegetation, bodily eruptions, and smallpox. The suitability branch develops through the idea of an endpoint or fitting place.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Presented as the comparative adjective أَجْدَرُ, ‘more fitting, apt, or likely,’ despite the QAC nominal tag.
Displayed under the singular dictionary citation form جِدَار.
جُدُر is the Quran-attested plural of جِدَار and is grouped under its singular citation form.

senses.definition: More fitting, apt, suitable, or worthy; hence more likely to do or be something.
senses.usage_conditions: Used in comparative constructions with بِـ, لِـ, or أَنْ; the Quranic occurrence expresses greater likelihood or aptitude rather than a physical meaning.

senses.definition: A wall; a raised, upright barrier or structure.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic usage, جِدَار emphasizes the wall’s projection and elevation, in contrast with حائط, which can emphasize enclosure. The plural form جُدُر is included under this citation form.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make, build, raise, or found a wall.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive Form I verb used of constructing a wall or enclosure.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be attacked by smallpox; of smallpox, to break out or come forth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a person, especially a child, contracting the disease, and of the disease erupting.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be adapted, apt, suitable, competent, proper, or worthy.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Constructed with بِـ or لِـ for the thing for which someone or something is suited, and with أَنْ for an action.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make or deem someone or something fit, suitable, proper, or worthy.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive causative use applied to a person or thing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To raise a building high or construct it firmly and strongly.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form VIII building verb, especially of substantial or elevated construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To retrace obliterated writing so that it becomes distinct, or to renew a faded figured design in cloth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized Form Q.Q. verb used of restoring legibility or renewing patterned work.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The foundation or base of a wall; also its side.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The word is also applied specifically to the ḥaṭīm of the Kaaba in one traditional usage because part of the original foundation is present there.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A fence or dam made to retain or confine water.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: May refer to a branch-built water barrier or to fences between houses that retain water.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Walled gardens, especially gardens of grapevines.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A plural usage referring to enclosed cultivated plots.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Smallpox, a disease producing fluid-filled pustules that later open and form thick matter.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional disease name; the related verb describes the eruption of its pustules.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Truffles, in an expression of disapproval.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative or transferred appellation recorded in traditional usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A place enclosed by a wall; a walled place.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal use distinct from the adjective meaning suitable or worthy.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Adapted, apt, suitable, proper, or worthy; naturally drawn toward something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with بِـ, لِـ, or أَنْ for the object or action concerned; this is the positive adjective corresponding to the comparative Quranic form أَجْدَرُ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An enclosure for camels, young livestock, sheep, or goats, especially one made of masses of stone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A livestock enclosure; the materials and animals named are conventional applications in the lexical evidence.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Nature, natural disposition, temperament, or an inherent property.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An abstract noun for an innate character or disposition.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Land in which smallpox is present or abundant.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An attributive description of land associated with the disease.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Having smallpox or being marked by smallpox, especially with a pockmarked face.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A passive participial adjective describing a person or a bodily appearance.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Newly emerging vegetation or growth protruding from the ground.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A noun for plant growth as it appears above the earth.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of land, to put forth emerging vegetation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form IV use describing the land’s production of such growth.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A single shoot or piece of vegetation emerging from the ground.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The singular designation for the emergent plant growth called جَدَر.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A swelling or lump appearing on the body.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The related adjective جَدْرَاء may describe a sheep affected by the corresponding skin condition; this usage is distinguished from ordinary smallpox terminology in some lexical reports.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A short person.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative or humorous derivative associated with the wall sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An endpoint or terminus, conceived as the point to which a matter comes.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An abstract extension explained through the image of something reaching a wall or limit.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A raised mark or swelling caused by biting, especially at an animal’s neck.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized bodily mark explained through the protruding appearance of the swelling.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Illustrative wall-related example; it adds no independent lexical meaning.
Restoration of writing or figured textile work.
Foundation and side of a wall, including the Kaaba application.
Fence or dam for retaining water.
Pointer-only cross-reference to the wall entry.
Positive adjective of suitability or worthiness.

cautions: أَجْدَرُ is presented as a comparative adjective because its lexical construction is one of comparative aptitude or worthiness, although QAC assigns it a nominal tag.
The plural Quranic form جُدُر is grouped with جِدَار under the singular dictionary citation form.
